component.name: BluMach
component.summary: Documented preservation and emulation of distinctive historical PCs

description.p: BluMach is a preservation-focused emulator derived from 86Box. It combines low-level x86 emulation with a curated historical catalogue, explicit evidence and reproducible machine configurations.
To use BluMach you will need firmware images for the machines you want to emulate. BluMach does not distribute proprietary firmware.
